packageRules.description: House-style titles: config:recommended sets chore/fix per package, so override it here; later rules set CI and FFmpeg.
SHA-pinned actions in one PR; Renovate rewrites the SHA and the version comment.
Repository and plugin dev dependencies (plugins ship no runtime dependencies): minor and patch in one PR, majors one by one.
Our own SDK is published from transcoda/transcoda's CI with provenance: no release-age wait (as in pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude), and its PR opens at once.

pnpm (the packageManager field): its own pull request, on core's Sunday-evening schedule and with the same release-age wait, so both repositories move to the same pnpm version in the same week. CI runs pnpm from this field against both checkouts.
Node.js: .node-version, engines and @types/node move together on the LTS line CI runs; majors by hand.
